comments.author: Caddy
comments.body:
NPC Location: Sacramento, near item shop?
Found only on certain days of the NA event cycle.

Contents: Guardian's Coat x1, Special Royal Staysail x1, Exquisite Ruby x1, Master's Secrets x1, Succotash (+50 vig food) x50, 3* Large Ship Blueprints x1, +30% speed boost 1h x1, Veil of Dominions (1hr) x1, PO1 x10, PO2 x10, PO3 x10, PO4 x10

Guardian's coat is memorial album entry for the "Rare Items Traveled by Train" MA (new MA that gives Dragoon Revolver, 60att handgun +2 gunfire +2 sniping +2 arms)
